title: SeaAbilities
description: SeaAbilities Is a plugin for the ones that want sea creatures and sea abilities on their server. Its really fun and its custom coded.
body:
SeaAbilities
SeaAbilities is a lightweight, drop-in Paper/Spigot plugin that gives every player on your server a unique, randomly assigned sea power — activated with a simple right-click. No commands, no config files, no setup. Just install and play.

🌊 What Does It Add?
Every player gets one of four ocean-themed abilities tied to their Heart of the Sea. Abilities are personal, cooldown-gated, and come with particle effects and sounds for satisfying feedback. Step into water and you'll automatically gain Water Breathing and Dolphin's Grace — because being in the sea should feel like the sea.

⚡ The Four Abilities
AbilityEffect🌊 TsunamiBlasts all nearby entities away with explosive force🐙 KrakenDamages every living entity around you🧊 FreezeTurns all surrounding water into ice instantly👑 Sea KingLaunches every nearby entity into the air

🎲 Reroll Your Ability
Don't like what you rolled? Craft a Sea Ability Reroller using Diamonds, Nautilus Shells, and a Heart of the Sea — then right-click it to randomize your ability. The item is consumed on use, giving players a meaningful crafting goal.

🤔 Why Download SeaAbilities?
Most ability plugins are bloated — dozens of powers, YAML configs, permission nodes, and setup guides just to get started. SeaAbilities is the opposite. Four abilities, one jar, zero configuration.
The random assignment is the real draw for SMPs. Every player has a different power, which creates natural variety and competition — someone has Kraken, someone has Freeze, and suddenly there's something to talk about. The reroller keeps the crafting loop alive without handing out power for free.
If you're running a Sea SMP, an ocean-themed event, or just want to give your survival server a layer of player identity, SeaAbilities fits in without disrupting balance or demanding ongoing admin work.

🔧 Details

Server software: Paper/Spigot 1.21.11
Java: 21+
Version: 3.0

Made by C0ld and Zkotax.
